description:
As a client and therapist
  I want reliable appointment booking, conflict detection, rescheduling, cancellation, date filtering, and slot optimization
  So that clinic calendars stay accurate and double bookings are prevented

elements.name: Client books an available therapy session with a therapist

steps.name: an onboarded therapist "maja_terapeut" with IBAN "DK5000400440116243", currency "DKK", and service "Individuel Terapi" priced at 2 DKK for 60 minutes in branch "PSYCHOLOGY"
a registered client "anders_sand" with an active handshake with therapist "maja_terapeut"
an authenticated client session for "anders_sand"
client "anders_sand" books an appointment with therapist "maja_terapeut" for service "Individuel Terapi" from "2026-11-20T10:00:00" to "2026-11-20T11:00:00"
the appointment booking should succeed with status "CONFIRMED"

elements.name: Double booking the same therapist in an overlapping time slot is rejected as a conflict

steps.name: an onboarded therapist "maja_terapeut" with IBAN "DK5000400440116243", currency "DKK", and service "Individuel Terapi" priced at 2 DKK for 60 minutes in branch "PSYCHOLOGY"

the appointment booking should succeed with status "CONFIRMED"
client "anders_sand" attempts to book an appointment with therapist "maja_terapeut" for service "Individuel Terapi" from "2026-11-21T14:30:00" to "2026-11-21T15:30:00"
the booking should be rejected as a scheduling conflict

elements.name: Booking with an end time not strictly after start time is rejected

steps.name: an onboarded therapist "maja_terapeut" with IBAN "DK5000400440116243", currency "DKK", and service "Individuel Terapi" priced at 2 DKK for 60 minutes in branch "PSYCHOLOGY"
a registered client "anders_sand" with an active handshake with therapist "maja_terapeut"
an authenticated client session for "anders_sand"
client "anders_sand" attempts to book an appointment with therapist "maja_terapeut" for service "Individuel Terapi" from "2026-11-22T15:00:00" to "2026-11-22T14:00:00"
the operation should be rejected with a validation error mentioning "after start time"

elements.name: Client reschedules and cancels a future appointment while historical dates are rejected

steps.name: an onboarded therapist "maja_terapeut" with IBAN "DK5000400440116243", currency "DKK", and service "Individuel Terapi" priced at 2 DKK for 60 minutes in branch "PSYCHOLOGY"

client "anders_sand" attempts to reschedule that appointment to "2023-01-01T10:00:00" until "2023-01-01T11:00:00"
the operation should be rejected with a validation error mentioning "in the past"
client "anders_sand" reschedules that appointment to "2026-11-24T11:00:00" until "2026-11-24T12:00:00"
the appointment start time should be updated to "2026-11-24T11:00:00"
client "anders_sand" cancels the scheduled appointment
the cancellation should complete successfully

As a clinic therapist and client
